clauses.title: The CL-D72 record states the three choices, the spawn-site rule, and the reset
clauses.section: ## CL-D72 — The focused validation is packaged and the alarm is reset for it
requires: Option A on all three
fails closed as `validation_failed` at phase `validation`
or as `harness_failed` at phase `spawn`
exactly one spawn site whose program is neither `git` nor the gh transports' literal `'gh'`, in `validation.js`
That guard is a structural check of reviewed source bounded to direct references, not a JavaScript evaluator
owner option A, https://github.com/tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents/issues/64#issuecomment-5670651510
a form outside this bound is not a finding against the guard
a literal name counts as a reference wherever it is written
every call of `transport` or `defaultTransport` passes the literal `'gh'`, and each gh transport spawns only the literal `'gh'`
a module loader other than `require`, `getBuiltinModule` or `mainModule`, appears nowhere
a literal Git argument list carries no `-c` configuration pair of its own
The timeout is enforced by SIGKILL and decides the outcome
a read beyond its bound fails closed as `output_limit` naming it
`absent` names only a file the head does not carry
are refused as references of any form
read from the syntax tree that Node's own bundled parser builds
A changed path whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 fails closed as `path_encoding`
resets from 220,000 to 240,000 bytes
the owner chose the step name (https://github.com/tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents/issues/64#issuecomment-5662628859
a changed symlink or submodule pointer is excluded and named with its mode in the result
owner option A, https://github.com/tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents/issues/64#issuecomment-5663434628
A second non-git spawn site, a shell string, a cwd below a toplevel, a program allowlist, or a further alarm raise requires a new owner decision
